entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: Papyrus 68, designated by 𝔓68, is a copy of the New Testament in Greek. It is a papyrus manuscript of the First Epistle to the Corinthians. The surviving texts of 1 Corinthians are verses 4:12-17; 4:19-5:3. The manuscript palaeographically has been assigned to the 7th century. Papyrus 68 is a manuscript. Classified as Tier A (Primary Source) evidence. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
